## Tour.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `steps` :: Ordered tour steps with target selectors and guidance copy.
- `open` :: Whether the tour overlay is visible; bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when the tour opens or closes.
- `current` :: Zero-based index of the active step; bindable.
- `onCurrentChange` :: Called whenever the active step changes.
- `onComplete` :: Called when finishing the final step.
- `onSkip` :: Called when skipping or dismissing the tour early.
- `spotlight` :: Highlight the active target element inside a spotlight cutout.
- `surface` :: The surface of the step card.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the step card.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the step title.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the step description.
- `metaTextSize` :: Text scale of the step counter.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the step description.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the step counter.
- `closeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the close IconButton beside the counter.
- `skipButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Skip Button in the action row.
- `backButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Back Button, which appears from the second step on.
- `nextButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Next/Done Button in the action row.

## tour.ts

### `interface TourStep`

One step of a guided tour.

- `target` :: A CSS selector, an element, or a function that returns one.

### `function resolveTourTarget`

The element a step points at, however it was written: a selector, an element, or a getter. `null` while there is no DOM, or when nothing matches.
